caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically-oriented wooden post with a rounded, carved finial at the top, resembling an acorn or knob. The post has a cylindrical shape with slight bulges near the top and base, creating simple decorative bands, and features natural wood grain and cracks throughout its surface. The wood is depicted in shades of light brown and pale aqua-green, with darker brown lines indicating texture and aging. The background is plain off-white, free of any additional objects or scenery. The artist’s name, "ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE," appears lightly in the lower right corner.
title: Carved Wooden Hitching Post
